## AccrualPosition.maxBorrowAssets property

The maximum amount of loan assets that can be borrowed against this position's collateral. `undefined` if the market's oracle is undefined or reverts.

**Signature:**

```typescript
get maxBorrowAssets(): bigint | undefined;
```
